Good Morning Katie,

 

This was some feedback from my educational leader.

 

 

Just wanted to pass on some feedback from the educators from last week’s incursion.

 

From their understanding, the incursion was meant to be around 10 minutes in Willow and 20 minutes in Eden. However, the Trainer arrived at 9am and was walking back out the door by around 9:20am, so it did seem quite short. One of the educators also mentioned that it felt like the session was more tailored towards the under 1’s.  The resources provided were not considered particularly different or engaging, as they were experiences and resources that we already offer to the children as part of our everyday program.

The session also felt quite rushed. While the children particularly enjoyed the bubbles, overall the experience felt quite basic, with activities such as touching an item and then placing it into a bag. The educators felt there could have been more opportunities for exploration, engagement and interaction with the children.

 

We feel a future session could be more valuable if it was tailored to the children's age groups, offered experiences that are different from what we already provide, and allowed more time for meaningful engagement.

 

Many thanks,

• Assign a primary and backup coach to each centre before the start date, with both completing induction and centre-specific briefings.

• Schedule weekly check-ins with centres during the first month to identify coverage gaps or coach performance issues before cancellations occur.

patterns.prevention:
• Schedule quarterly check-ins with centre directors during months 2 and 3 of contracts to identify satisfaction issues and competitive threats before cancellation notices arrive.

• Create a retention offer package (discounted rates, flexible scheduling, custom program formats) ready to deploy when centres mention budget constraints or scheduling conflicts.

• Reach out to centres 6-8 weeks before term breaks to confirm bookings and offer to adjust session times, preventing last-minute cancellations due to scheduling mismatches.

• Document competitor intelligence from exit interviews and share monthly with state managers to identify which providers are converting our clients and adjust positioning accordingly.
